address: 15F, Fairfield, 999 Binhe Road, Huqiu, Suzhou, China Mainland
bio: Chai Court, which opened its doors in 2012, focuses on authentic Cantonese classics with the occasional creative twist and seasonal dishes. The menu covers all bases, featuring slow-cooked soups, Cantonese barbecues and stir-fries. It's advisable to pre-order popular items such as the deep-fried pigeon with crispy skin and silky, juicy flesh. The main dining room is spacious and cosy; the private rooms are ideal for banquets and dinner parties....
